independent_replay.lean_cli_summary: 159/1159 unique nonzero finite homology classes accepted
independent_replay.method: Exhaustive all Boolean matrices with m<=2 and k,n<=2, plus m=3 and k,n<=1; every named vector; independent complete homotopy and quotient-coset checks; one Lean CLI batch replay.

limitations: The proposition concerns the entire supplied finite matrix complex; no identification with an actual Adams page is supplied by this interface.
The producer may output a candidate with homology dimension other than one; Lean rejects it as documented.
Successful import/CLI checking does not provide a proof about external topology; the goal-bound tactic and mathematical interpretation premises remain required.
The independent exhaustive replay is finite engineering evidence and does not replace the universal Lean soundness theorem.
proof_review: IsUniqueNonzeroClass quantifies every cycle in the entire supplied matrix complex.
The complete comparison checks incoming and outgoing matrices, projection/inclusion identities, and a contracting-homotopy identity on the entire input space.
The named vector is checked to be a cycle with nonzero coordinate in a one-dimensional full quotient.
The one-bit dichotomy and comparison boundary-coset equivalence prove every cycle is either a boundary or homologous to the named vector.
The goal-bound Certificate is indexed by outgoing, incoming and named; a certificate for different input cannot silently change the requested proposition.
Wire dimension checks prevent matrixOf and Stage.vector default-false access from filling omitted data.
Strict canonical JSON comparison rejects unknown or duplicate fields, including nested comparison fields.
Both Fact 7.6(4) optional-boundary choices use the full comparison and retain their separate actual-Adams interpretation obligations.
The C++ producer is untrusted; import creates data and the tactic kernel-reduces a proved sound checker.
